title: Finance Associate
must_have: 1+ years of experience in corporate finance
text:
Finance Associate
Hoysala Group | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a finance associate to join our corporate finance team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Financial Modelling
- Advanced Excel
- Tally
- Variance Analysis
- GST Compliance
- 1+ years of experience in corporate finance

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Treasury Management
- Forecasting
- SQL
- Ind AS

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive quarterly board reporting with measurable outcomes.
- Drive cost-centre review process with measurable outcomes.
- Drive vendor payment cycle with measurable outcomes.
